summary_en: The study tests rezatapopt (PC14586), an oral p53 reactivator, alone or with pembrolizumab, in advanced solid tumors that have a TP53 Y220C mutation. Rezatapopt is taken by mouth once daily, with doses increased in steps during Phase 1 and 2000 mg daily with food in the expansion cohorts, and pembrolizumab 200 mg IV is given every 3 weeks in the combination arms; treatment duration is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it describes assessing safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy, and the study is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa rezatapopt (PC14586), un medicamento oral que reactiva p53, solo o con pembrolizumab, en tumores sólidos avanzados con la mutación TP53 Y220C. El rezatapopt se toma por vía oral una vez al día, con dosis que aumentan por etapas en la Fase 1 y con 2000 mg diarios con alimentos en las cohortes de expansión, y el pembrolizumab 200 mg por vía intravenosa se administra cada 3 semanas en los brazos de combinación; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El registro no indica una medida principal de resultado; describe la evaluación de seguridad, tolerabilidad, farmacocinética y eficacia, y el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a TP53 Y220C mutation
Previously treated with one or more lines of anticancer therapy and progressive disease
Age 18 or older, or 12 to 17 with Safety Review Committee approval
Combination part: anti-PD-1/PD-L1 naive or progressed on that treatment, with measurable disease
not_for: Known KRAS single nucleotide variant (monotherapy phase; ovarian cancer exception)
Brain metastases unless neurologically stable and not needing steroids
Active, uncontrolled hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV infection
Recent stroke, heart attack, or other heart conditions within stated time windows
Known active malignancy, other than treated cervical intraepithelial neoplasia or non-melanoma skin cancer
